safetyNotes.note: Earlier worker behavior moved uploaded files from yes into processing/failed when conversion output was rejected, making files appear deleted.
Current code preserves library originals by default and writes .media-ingest.json receipts beside final outputs.
When debugging disappearing files, check media-processing/failed, active, originals, and receipts before blaming SpiritFlix.

importantFiles.file: Reads Face Organizer sidecars and enrolled/model index data. POST-only route. Uses basename/stem matching and visual_confirmed decisions.
Builds model groups and model card counts from visible Jellyfin items plus face metadata.

countSemantics.note: SpiritFlix model cards should show visible Jellyfin item counts, not organizer-only sidecar/source counts.
Organizer can show more source/model-folder files than SpiritFlix if Jellyfin has not exposed the file or the file is outside the visible library query.

deployNotes.note: After editing source repo files, copy changed files into /tmp/spiritos-spiritflix-stable-3001, run npm build, then restart port 3001.
Do not assume the source repo change is live on 3001 until copied, built, and restarted.
